title: MBIAS: Mitigating Bias in Large Language Models While Retaining Context

bias_targets.methodology: Using an LLM-as-a-judge (DeepEval framework) to calculate bias and toxicity scores on model outputs corresponding to the 'Women' demographic from the ToxiGen dataset.

Using an LLM-as-a-judge to evaluate bias and toxicity scores on generated texts for various racial and ethnic demographics (Black, Chinese, Asian, Native American, Middle Eastern, Mexican, Latino) from the ToxiGen dataset.
Using an LLM-as-a-judge to evaluate bias and toxicity scores on generated texts involving 'Mental Disability' and 'Physical Disability' demographics from the ToxiGen dataset.
Using an LLM-as-a-judge to calculate bias and toxicity scores on generated outputs concerning 'Muslim' and 'Jewish' demographics from the ToxiGen dataset.
Using an LLM-as-a-judge to calculate bias and toxicity scores on model outputs regarding the 'LGBTQ' demographic from the ToxiGen dataset.
Qualitative evaluation and human assessment of text debiasing performance on prompts containing age-related stereotypes (e.g., comparing younger and older workers).
Qualitative evaluation and human assessment of text debiasing performance on prompts containing prejudices about wealth, education levels, and geographic locations.
